result.summary: This source describes a small local web application designed to assist users during a live 12-team, full-PPR snake fantasy football draft on Sleeper. The main goal of the tool is to provide real-time pick tracking and recommendations based on expert consensus rankings.

The app tracked every pick in real time and recommended who to take next.

The default rankings blend FantasyPros consensus and ESPN Field Yates PPR rankings.
A player on both lists gets FantasyPros_rank × 0.6 + ESPN_rank × 0.4, and the list is re-sorted by that blended score.
The app fetches picks every 3 seconds.
Sleeper's CDN caches the picks endpoint for up to 30 seconds.
My Team and Needs tracker automatically detects your own picks and slots them into starting slots.

facts.fact: The first version used `replacement_rank − position_rank` alone.

facts.section: The Value Model > How the model evolved
facts.fact: This first version answered the 2.10 question by favoring the RB11 over the TE1, but it let scarcity override real differences in talent.
The 'My Team' empty in mock drafts bug was caused by Sleeper leaving `roster_id` null on mock-draft picks.
The fix for the 'My Team' empty in mock drafts bug was to identify picks by `draft_slot`, which is set in both mock and real drafts.
Check for an API before building scraping or screenshot reading.
Test on a mock draft before relying on the app live.
